newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar down as consumer buying peters out.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar down as consumer buying peters out.

text.p: Sugar prices suffered a setback at the improved level on Thursday as fresh consumer buying petered out while improved supplies triggered light profit-taking by local stockists, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 lost gained ground by 8/15 rupees at 1,430/1,450 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 slid by 5 rupees at 1,470/1,505 rupees per quintal.
"Outstation buying at the mill level turned slow today and higher offerings by the millers have improved supplies of sugar from the mills to the Bombay market," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery moved down by 5 rupees at 1,360/1,370 rupees per quintal.
Overall trading volume remained slow during the day and sentiment was subdued at the close of the session.
"Sugar prices are likely to move in narrow price band next week," the broker added.
